description: This file defines the `FailedSessionBackoffProvider` class, which implements backoff logic for failed Orleans sessions, likely as part of a rebalancing process. It uses configuration options from `ActivationRebalancerOptions` and inherits from `FixedBackoff`. It also implements the `IFailedSessionBackoffProvider` interface.

classes.name: FailedSessionBackoffProvider
classes.description: A backoff provider for handling failed sessions during Orleans rebalancing, configured with options and inheriting from FixedBackoff.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of FailedSessionBackoffProvider with the specified options, setting up backoff timing based on the session cycle period.
